text:
lina: morning! first day remote 👋 quick question — I can't open most observability dashboards. Grafana redirects to a 403, Datadog shows 'no access', and Sentry pages say 'not a member'. who do I ping for basic read access?

devex: welcome Lina 🎉 — cc @maria for access. quick checklist: are you signed into Okta + using the company SSO?

lina: yep signed into Okta, email verified. SSO works for email and slack only. trying grafana URL: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal gives 403.

maria: hey Lina! I'll help. can you paste the exact Grafana URL and a screenshot? also which org/email did you sign in with (work account)?

lina: pasted URL above, signed in with lina@redwood.ai. screenshot: (attached).

maria: thanks. quick try — open an incognito window and sign in via Okta there. sometimes a stale cookie maps to a different org and gives 403. if that fails, i'll kick off the group assignment.

lina: incognito still 403. happy to be added to read-only. what's the process?

devex: we use the access-request app. two options: 1) run the CLI helper (fast), or 2) file a ticket. CLI: run `obs-access request --user lina@redwood.ai --groups observability-read,grafana-view --tools grafana,datadog,sentry`

lina: I don't have the CLI installed yet. can I file a ticket instead?

devex: sure — file to #it-access or use the web form: https://id.redwood.ai/request-access. put the subject: "New hire access: grafana/datadog/sentry (lina@redwood.ai)" and mention onboarding. That usually gets processed in < 2 hours.

maria: I'll expedite after you file it. also note: Datadog dashboards are in the team folder 'runtime/serving' and Grafana dashboard perms are org-level; we'll add you to the 'eng-observability' group. Sentry: you'll get invited to the org once group is applied.

alex: fyi if you need immediate read access to a specific panel, DM me which dashboard and I'll share a permalink snapshot until the group is added.

lina: thanks! filing the form now.

onboarding-bot: ticket #IT-4821 created by lina@redwood.ai — Subject: New hire access: grafana/datadog/sentry — ETA: 90 minutes — Link: https://id.redwood.ai/tickets/IT-4821

maria: got it — I'll attach a note to prioritize. @sam-eng can help if any SSO mapping is weird.

sam-eng: taking a look now. if the Okta attribute 'redwoodOrg' didn't propagate, i'll run a sync and re-trigger the invite. expecting to finish in ~30m.

lina: great, thanks everyone. any recommended dashboards for a first pass?

maria: start with runtime:latency-overview (Grafana), then datadog: serving->p99/p95 tokens, and Sentry: errors -> new issues. i'll drop links in a follow-up DM.

alex: also check the onboarding doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/observability/onboarding — it has a short "first 30m" checklist and a few saved filters.

lina: perfect. appreciate the help! 🙏

maria: welcome again! will update here when access is done.

sam-eng: sync completed, re-invited lina@redwood.ai to Grafana org. please try again in 5m and report back.

lina: I can load Grafana now, and Datadog looks good too. Sentry still pending invite but page now shows 'pending org membership'.

maria: Sentry invite just sent — accept via email. once accepted, ping me for recommended alert filters.

lina: accepted! everything works. thanks for the speedy help everyone 🚀
